protocol.scope: Development sensitivity study on the already-used Toros diagnostic clip; no final-test claim and no production parameter selection
protocol.inputs: Frozen raw detector boxes from phase3 capture job 129692, both original checkpoints, all 479 original frames
protocol.unchanged: Detector weights and outputs, native 30fps timeline, original 40/60 regions, stable 3 samples, gap reset 2 seconds, event matching 2 seconds
protocol.baseline_gate: Standalone tracker replay must reproduce the complete frozen event lists exactly for both models before interpreting variants
protocol.evaluation: Temporal event TP/FP/FN as before; append publisher-reference ID support at each event using framewise IoU>=0.5 association, without feeding reference information to tracker or counter
protocol.generalisation_gate: Do not choose the final config from this clip; evaluate candidates on separately annotated held-out sessions and include collisions, reversals and opposing traffic
